dataset_title: Quick-Fold Laundry Sorting Mat Competitive Pricing Research

venture.concept: A portable, hinged garment-folding mat intended to make laundry folding faster, more consistent, and usable in small spaces.
target_customers: Seniors or people with limited mobility
venture.value_proposition: For busy people with limited space, the Quick-Fold Mat aims to deliver fast, uniform folds in different settings, with magnetic latches, an anti-slip surface, portability, and durable flexible hinges.

geographic_market.working_scope: United States online retail market for comparable products
geographic_market.assumption: No city, state, or launch geography was provided; U.S. online listings in USD are used as an initial benchmark.

channels: Online marketplaces and e-commerce are venture opportunities stated in the brief; no final channel decision is provided.
features: Durable hinged panels, intended for thousands of folds (venture brief claim, not independently validated)
Magnetic latches hold panels/folds in position
Portable and intended for home, dorm, small apartment, shared laundry room, and travel use
unknowns: Manufacturing cost, BOM, target margin, and final dimensions not provided
Primary customer survey/interview findings not provided

competitors.name: FlipFold
competitors.geography: United States; official site says it also ships to Canada and the UK
competitors.target_customers: Households, students, and institutional/commercial users seeking uniform garment folds; brand names retailers, manufacturers, screen printers, embroiderers, and personal use.
competitors.products: Adult and Junior shirt/laundry folders; adult and adult/junior multi-packs.
competitors.positioning: Established branded folding tool with USA manufacture claim and premium direct-to-consumer price versus basic folders.
competitors.differentiators: Four-panel hinged polypropylene board; non-skid rubber bumpers; airflow holes to reduce static; instructions for common garments; adult fold size 9 x 12 in, junior 7 x 10 in (FAQ).
competitors.reason: Closest established U.S. branded folding-board substitute and useful premium benchmark.

competitors.name: BoxLegend
competitors.geography: U.S.-facing online store; USD prices; shipping charged at checkout, free shipping threshold over $25 shown on homepage.
competitors.target_customers: Consumers and households seeking fast folding and closet organization; product messaging includes family use and seasonal clothing storage.
competitors.products: V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, and V7 shirt folder boards.
competitors.positioning: Broad value-to-mid-market product ladder with several board versions and one promotional V7 reference price.
competitors.differentiators: Multiple board designs/versions; official site promotes quick folding and organization; V7 price is explicitly marked sale. Product-level material/specification distinctions were not consistently available on the homepage.
competitors.reason: Current direct brand with multiple public price points and a useful accessible-price benchmark.

competitors.name: Household Essentials
competitors.geography: United States; product price checked on Target U.S. listing.
competitors.target_customers: General household consumers seeking a simple shirt-folding aid.
competitors.products: Shirt Folding Board for T-shirts, polos, and dress shirts (Target listing; partner-supplied detail).
competitors.positioning: Mass-market basic utility item at a low-to-mid price, distributed through mainstream retail.
competitors.differentiators: Step-by-step instructions; smooth-glide handle that removes folded garments and doubles as a hanging hook; plastic, foldaway construction.
competitors.reason: A familiar retail alternative with similar use and distribution likely to overlap with students and households.

competitors.name: Hang It Up Laundry Service
competitors.classification: Direct (niche product) / indirect (laundry service) means of reducing folding hassle
competitors.geography: Laundry service business; service geography not established from product page. Online product listing.
competitors.target_customers: Customers who want an attractive, easy-to-handle board; service customers seeking less laundry work.
competitors.products: Custom acrylic Folding Board; the business also presents itself as a laundry service.
competitors.positioning: Small-batch, design-led accessory positioned around the provider’s laundry service experience.
competitors.differentiators: Clear acrylic, handle for removing the board, elongated format for multiple garment sizes; 7.5 x 11 in and 3 mm thick.
competitors.reason: A highly relevant small-business product example whose handle and format are points of comparison for the venture’s ergonomic design.

pricing_comparison.basis: Representative listed one-time board prices for four competitors; excludes bundle totals, the BoxLegend V3 sold-out listing, and BoxLegend V7 sale price because V2 is the selected representative. Prices are not adjusted for shipping/tax and product features are not identical.

all_publicly_listed_offer_range.note: Range includes two-board bundles and BoxLegend’s sale reference offers, so it is not a like-for-like unit-price range.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.position: Above the lowest-price acrylic/basic boards and around-to-below the premium FlipFold adult board.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.rationale: A $19.99–$29.99 range is a hypothesis supported by the observed $10–$19.99 alternatives and $39.99 FlipFold single-board benchmark. Magnetic latches, grip, and portable use could support a modest premium over simple boards, but the venture’s cost, actual performance, willingness to pay, and prototype usability are unknown.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.status: Preliminary; not a final price and not an optimal-price claim.

limitations: No launch geography or brand name was specified; U.S. online prices are used as an assumption.
Prices and availability can change; checked 2026-10-27.
Shipping, tax, discounts at checkout, and third-party marketplace dynamics excluded.
BoxLegend homepage lists six variants but accessible detail and current inventory are limited; V3 was explicitly sold out.
Household Essentials price/specifications are from a Target Plus partner listing (partially verified), not the brand’s own product page.
Hang It Up service footprint and shipping terms are not stated on the folding-board page.
No apples-to-apples controlled test of folding time, fold consistency, material durability, magnetic-latch utility, or portability was available.
The venture workspace contains no validated manufacturing cost, target margin, prototype test, primary research findings, or willingness-to-pay data.
Competitor prices benchmark listed products; they do not establish optimal demand or profitability.
